allow: PowerShell($r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api-rac-n-play.vercel.app/api/data/all?event=pesquisa" -Method Get; $d = $r.tables.dados_respostas_pesquisas.data; Write-Output "COUNT: $\($d.Count\)"; Write-Output "--- MATRIZES ---"; $d | Group-Object matriz | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.Name\) : $\($_.Count\)" }; Write-Output "--- EVENTOS ---"; $d | Group-Object evento | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.Name\) : $\($_.Count\)" }; Write-Output "--- SECOES ---"; $d | Group-Object secao | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.Name\) : $\($_.Count\)" }; Write-Output "--- STATUS ---"; $d | Group-Object status_pesquisa | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.Name\) : $\($_.Count\)" }; Write-Output "--- CLIENTES ---"; $d | Group-Object cliente | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.Name\) : $\($_.Count\)" })

PowerShell($r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api-rac-n-play.vercel.app/api/data/all?event=pesquisa" -Method Get; $d = $r.tables.dados_respostas_pesquisas.data; Write-Output "--- CAMPOS ---"; $d[0].PSObject.Properties.Name -join ", "; Write-Output "--- NOTAS ---"; $d | Group-Object nota | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object { "nota=$\($_.Name\) : $\($_.Count\)" }; Write-Output "--- NAO SE APLICA ---"; $d | Group-Object secao_nao_se_aplica | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.Name\) : $\($_.Count\)" }; Write-Output "--- JURIDICO PARTICIPOU ---"; $d | Group-Object juridico_participou | ForEach-Object { "[$\($_.Name\)] : $\($_.Count\)" }; Write-Output "--- GERENTES ---"; $d | Group-Object gerente | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.Name\) : $\($_.Count\)" }; Write-Output "--- ASSESSORES ---"; $d | Group-Object assessor | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.Name\) : $\($_.Count\)" }; Write-Output "--- COMENTARIOS ---"; $d | Where-Object { $_.comentario_secao } | Select-Object evento, secao, comentario_secao -Unique | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String)

PowerShell(try { $a = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api-rac-n-play.vercel.app/api/data/all" -Method Get -TimeoutSec 30; Write-Output "=== SEM EVENT PARAM ==="; $a | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 2 -Compress | ForEach-Object { $_.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(2000, $_.Length\)\) } } catch { Write-Output "ERRO: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
